historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes the reservation command but does not define ID parsing, ownership, lifetime, dependent use or contention handling.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats reservation as stateful coordination rather than a harmless read and requires a bounded approved consumer.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A successful Reserve SDR response creates transient repository state whose usefulness and risk depend on the next operation. Creating independent IB and OOB reservations without ordering rules can invalidate or replace the first reservation, so the dual-path test cannot be an uncoordinated pair of commands.

original_test_intent: Exercise SDR repository reservation through verified in-band and out-of-band paths, validate returned reservation identifiers and prove a controlled lifecycle without modifying SDR contents.
original_method: Verify both paths and baseline repository metadata, obtain approval for one dependent allowlist and path order, issue only the required 0x0A/0x22 requests, parse completion and two-byte little-endian IDs, observe cross-path invalidation/expiry behavior, end the bounded sequence and verify repository integrity.
manual_activity: The owner approves the target, exact dependent sequence, IB/OOB order, reservation lifetime and contention recovery; the package owner validates lifecycle handling; the operator reviews any loss or repository change and sets the verdict.
required_inputs: Whether both path reservations may coexist
safety_requirements: Do not reserve without an immediate approved dependent purpose
Do not issue repeated reservations to obtain a preferred ID
Never treat reservation as authorization to add, delete or clear SDRs
Stop on cross-path invalidation or unexpected repository change
Allow supported expiry instead of forcing cleanup
agent_execution_scope: Verify same target and baseline metadata
Validate approved path order and dependent allowlist
Issue one reservation per required path
Parse and bind IDs to path and time
Archive lifecycle evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve reservation purpose and dependent allowlist
Approve IB/OOB order and concurrency policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Raw 0x0A/0x22 matches the source, but the IB wrapper omits `ipmitool`, exposes unsafe transport choices and does not bind returned IDs to a controlled lifecycle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected same-target runners and a lifecycle coordinator that issues 0x0A/0x22 only for an approved immediate dependent sequence, validates each two-byte ID and stops on invalidation or contention.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The IB/OOB reservation objective and 5/5-minute envelope are preserved; ordering and lifecycle gates prevent unbounded transient state.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain a reservation ledger containing path, request/response bytes, parsed ID, creation time, repository generation metadata, dependent operation, invalidation/expiry event and final integrity check.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds same-target proof, ID parsing, explicit purpose, cross-path ordering, contention detection and lifecycle closure while removing log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command success alone does not establish a valid ID, usable lifetime, coexistence across paths or repository integrity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some BMCs permit only one current reservation; the second path may intentionally invalidate the first. That behavior must be classified by the approved platform contract, not guessed from two successful responses.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether the goal is independently proving each transport or concurrent reservations, and which dependent read/operation consumes each ID. Add, Partial Add, Delete and Clear SDR remain separately governed cases.
expected_evidence: Target identity, repository baseline and owner approval
Redacted raw requests/responses with parsed two-byte IDs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and procedure consistently request SDR reservation on both paths. Missing lifecycle and concurrency semantics are required implementation inputs, not competing source objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The reservation contract and dependent allowlist are obtainable project inputs. Execution blocks if lifecycle, cross-path semantics or safe contention control cannot be established.

review_improvement: Makes a transient stateful command auditable by binding each reservation to a purpose, path, duration and integrity outcome instead of accepting two return codes.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reservation IDs are not durable locks and can be invalidated by repository changes or another reservation. Sequential IB/OOB success may therefore mask that the first token is already unusable. Acceptance must test the approved ordering and token lifecycle while recording repository metadata, and it must not create a mutation merely to demonstrate token use unless another case authorizes that mutation.
